validation: Last six chronological SE003 Train characters; first 12 are the calibration pool
swlda_sampling: Enumerate all combinations of six complete historical EDF files; average subsets within subject before macro averaging
primary_metric: Validation flash ROC-AUC, subject macro mean
channel_selection: Fixed 16 channels; no learned channel selection
session_contrast: Mean pure-S2 subset AUC minus mean pure-S1 subset AUC within subject, for equal H=1,2,3
undefined: H=0,k=0 has no model; do not report accuracy or a current-only comparison at k=0

eegnet_plan.status: manifest only; no EEGNet implementation or training in this analysis
eegnet_plan.checkpoint_selection: None; fixed epoch count must be specified before future training
eegnet_plan.subsets: Five seeded selections per H, shared across k; repeated subsets across seeds are allowed, including identical H=0 and H=6 selections

scope: Exploratory, after seeing prior test results. Train validation only. Do not open Test, retune per H, omit unfavorable subsets, or change main/test results. Character accuracy is descriptive only.
